crossRefs.note: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

translations.web: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
translations.bsb: Can a man walk on hot coals without scorching his feet?
translations.kjv: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
translations.asv: Or can one walk upon hot coals, And his feet not be scorched?
